sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_APM_SEND SET KEY_8 = #RTN_MSG# , KEY_9 = #RTN_FLAG# , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID#
sqlMap.select:
SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY, B.DOCU_NO, B.PASS_STATUS, B.EXTIF_TP, B.EXTIF_NO, B.EXTIF_COUNT, B.CUR_ORDER_NO, C.USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOGDOCU B , ICOGPASSLN C , ICOMLUSR D WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# AND A.BUYER = B.COMPANY AND A.DOC_NO = B.DOCU_NO
AND D.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND D.LEGACY_USER_ID = #APPR_SGID#
AND C.COMPANY = B.COMPANY AND C.DOCU_NO = B.DOCU_NO AND C.USER_ID = D.USER_ID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOGPASSLN SET PASS_DATE = TO_DATE(#PASS_DATE#, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') , REFER_DATE= TO_DATE(#PASS_DATE#, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') , PASS_KN = #PASS_KN# , PASS_ADD = #PASS_ADD# WHERE COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND USER_ID = #USER_ID#
sqlMap.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(ORDER_NO) AS ORDER_NO FROM ICOGPASSLN WHERE 1 = 1 AND COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND PASS_TP = #PASS_TP# AND PASS_KN IS NULL ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(ORDER_NO)

UPDATE ICOGDOCU SET PASS_STATUS = #PASS_STATUS# WHERE (COMPANY, DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# AND CREATE_DATM > TO_DATE('20180401', 'YYYYMMDD') ) AND PASS_STATUS NOT IN ('1','3')
UPDATE ICOGDOCU SET CUR_ORDER_NO = #CUR_ORDER_NO# , PASS_STATUS = #PASS_STATUS# WHERE COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO#
UPDATE ICOGDOCU SET PASS_STATUS='4' WHERE (COMPANY,DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# )
UPDATE ICOGPASSLN SET PASS_KN='4' , PASS_ADD=#PASS_ADD# WHERE (COMPANY,DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# )

SELECT DISTINCT C.BUYER, C.PR_NO FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOMTRGW B , ICOMPRDT C WHERE A.KEY_1 = #APPR_ID#
AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND A.DOC_NO = B.TARGET
AND B.COM_CODE = C.BUYER AND B.KEY_1 = C.REF_NO
sqlMap.update:
UPDATE ICOMPRDT SET RECV_FLAG = #RECV_FLAG# , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS')
WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PR_NO = #PR_NO#

UPDATE ICOMBDGT A SET A.TEMP_AMT = A.TEMP_AMT - (SELECT NVL(SUM(TARGET_QTY * TARGET_PRICE),0) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND BUDGET_DEPT||ACCOUNT_TYPE = A.DEPT||A.ACCOUNT_TYPE AND PLAN_AMT_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY BUDGET_DEPT , ACCOUNT_TYPE ) WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND DEPT||ACCOUNT_TYPE IN ( SELECT BUDGET_DEPT||ACCOUNT_TYPE FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND PLAN_AMT_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY BUDGET_DEPT , ACCOUNT_TYPE ) AND (SELECT MAX(ADD_DATE) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# ) BETWEEN A.FROM_DATE AND A.TO_DATE

MERGE INTO HWIN_APPR_STATUS A USING ( SELECT #APPRID# AS APPRID FROM DUAL ) B ON ( 1 = 1 AND A.APPRID = B.APPRID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET APPRSTATUSCD = #APPRSTATUSCD#, APPRTRANSSTATUSCD = #APPRTRANSSTATUSCD#, APPRKEY = #APPRKEY#, APPRREVNO = #APPRREVNO#, APPRSUBMITDT = #APPRSUBMITDT#, APPRCONFIRMDT = #APPRCONFIRMDT#, INSERTUID = #INSERTUID#, INSERTDT = #INSERTDT#, UPDATEUID = #UPDATEUID#, UPDATEDT = #UPDATEDT#, ERRORDETAIL = #ERRORDETAIL# WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( APPRID, APPRSTATUSCD, APPRTRANSSTATUSCD, APPRKEY, APPRREVNO, APPRSUBMITDT, APPRCONFIRMDT, INSERTUID, INSERTDT, UPDATEUID, UPDATEDT, ERRORDETAIL ) VALUES ( #APPRID#, #APPRSTATUSCD#, #APPRTRANSSTATUSCD#, #APPRKEY#, #APPRREVNO#, #APPRSUBMITDT#, #APPRCONFIRMDT#, #INSERTUID#, #INSERTDT#, #UPDATEUID#, #UPDATEDT#, #ERRORDETAIL# )
